description: MainActivity.java is an Android Activity class responsible for managing the UI and interactions of an Eliza Chat application on an Android device. It handles lifecycle events, starts/resumes a responder service, and processes broadcast messages to update the chat history view.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is the main entry point of the Android app. It manages UI interactions, handles broadcast messages to update chat history, and controls the lifecycle of the responder service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, registers the broadcast receiver, and starts the responder service with an incoming action.

methods.name: startResponderService
methods.description: Creates and starts a responder service with the specified action.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the broadcast receiver and starts the conversation retrieval process; resets chat history display.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters the broadcast receiver to avoid leaks.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming intents to extract messages and updates the chat history TextView.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, e.g., stopping the responder service.
